value: An RPG Where You Can Have Sex With Any Villager
Minimal RPG where you raise the affinity of a handful of NPCs by gifting monster drops to view minigts scenes while resting.

You are banished from the town for being a useless Warrior. Your last hope is a nearby village, which was recently ransacked by weak monsters. In return for returning some of their resources from the monsters, you hope to gain their trust and start a new life.
